title: The Louse and the Flea
logline: A careful louse who has lived unnoticed in a rich man's bed lets a cocky, hungry flea stay the night; he bites too soon, wakes the house, escapes into a crack, and it is the louse who is found and thrown out.
moral: A reckless companion brings his trouble onto the careful one who took him in; and the place that looks soft and safe is safe only for those who are patient. (The script states no moral sentence; the film shows it and adds no moral text.)
tone: Small-scale comic suspense that turns quietly sad: a giant-and-tiny world, a ticking SLEEP meter, slapstick servants, then an empty hiding place. No gloating and no on-screen harm.

beats.summary: A little louse lives at the edge of a rich man's mattress.
Her rule: come out only when he sleeps, move quietly. It works.
A flea hops in through the window looking for a bed.
The warning: wait for deep sleep, be gentle, do not hurry (SLEEP meter set up).
The flea brushes it off: I know what to do.
Hunger beats patience; the louse stays hidden.
The man is not fully asleep: the meter is short of DEEP.
The flea leaps and bites hard.
The eyes snap open; the man leaps up shouting.
Servants with lamps search the bed.
The guilty flea escapes into a crack in the floor.
The innocent louse, in her old safe place, is seen.
She is caught and got rid of (flicked out of the window).
The flea looks at the bed where she no longer lives: the empty nook.
He leaves the place that had seemed comfortable and safe.

sets.description: Room-scale rich bedchamber, 1000 x 1230, floor line y 900. Navy dotted wall; yellow floor tiles (110 wide, black grout) y 900..1230 with a crack at (480, 960); door x 40..180, y 520..900 (opens to a yellow light wedge); arched window x 250..450, y 250..470 with sill and a day/night sky; red drape swag with gold tassels across the top (y 0..160); bed: frame x 300..880, mattress top y 770, mattress front face y 770..840 with a yellow piping line at y 790, legs to y 900, gold headboard x 850..890, y 540..840, two white pillows x 720..850, y 715..770, red blanket with yellow trim over x 320..730 hanging over the front to y 810 for x 340..560; gold chest x 900..980, y 800..900; slippers at (640, 905). The louse nook is on the piping at (610, 790). Options: {time: day|dusk|night, door: 0..1, blanketOff: 0..1}.

Macro world on the bedding, 1000 x 1230, blanket surface (ground) y 900. View 'bed': red blanket with yellow dots, wrinkle lines; below it the mattress side (white, blue dots) with a fat yellow piping band at y 960; the nook: a turned-back blanket fold forming an arch x 90..290, y 800..900, navy inside, home point (190, 900); a loose thread curl at (300, 895); the giant right hand and forearm entering from the right: fingertips x 520, hand x 520..700 top y 790, forearm x 700..1000 top y 700..720, sleeve cuff from x 860; bite point (780, 712); background giant sleeping face, pale and thin-lined, eye at (800, 420) eye width 110, with fields lid, brow, mouth. View 'floor': tiles ground y 900, grout crack x 620..700 (60 deep, navy), bed leg column x 0..150, dark mattress underside y 0..220 for x 0..700, moon patch on the tiles x 760..960. Options: {view, dip:[x, depth], armShift, finger, dimple, lit: lamp disc position}.

props.description: Round magnifier inset (circle r 130..190 with a fat black brush ring and a tapering pointer to a world point) that shows the macro world inside a room-scale shot.
SLEEP meter: a label and a ten-segment bar with a DEEP mark at segment 9, drawn in panel space at the top left; built from the style box/counter primitives.
Generic thought cloud large enough to stage a picture in (planned effect, same name as other stories).
Giant finger and thumb for the macro set: the twitching index finger of the sleeper and the servant's pinch (pinch 0..1).
Small brass hand lamp with a flame, carried by the servants, plus its light: a yellow halftone disc (lampLight) over a night-blue room.
The flea's bundle: a red spotted cloth knotted on a short stick; later his napkin; finally left behind beside the empty nook.
The window sky running day to dusk to night (sun sets, moon rises) with a matching wall tint: the planned dayCycle effect clipped to the window.

subtitles.ar: عاشت قملة صغيرة في فراش رجل غني.|كانت تختبئ بين أطراف الفراش طوال النهار،|ولا تخرج إلا عندما ينام الرجل.|كانت تتحرك بهدوء، حتى لا يشعر بها أحد.
subtitles.en: A little louse lived in a wealthy man’s bed.|She hid along the edges of the bedding all day|and came out only when the man was asleep.|She moved quietly so that no one noticed her.

subtitles.ar: وفي ليلة، جاء برغوث يبحث عن مكان ينام فيه.|رأى الفراش الناعم فقال للقملة:|«ما أجمل هذا المكان! اسمحي لي أن أبقى معك الليلة.»|رحّبت به القملة، لكنها كانت قلقة.
subtitles.en: One night, a flea came looking for a place to sleep.|He saw the soft bed and told the louse,|“What a lovely place! Let me stay with you tonight.”|The louse welcomed him, but she was worried.

subtitles.ar: قالت له: «يمكنك البقاء، لكن انتبه جيدًا.|هذا الرجل يستيقظ بسرعة إذا شعر بلدغة قوية.|انتظر حتى ينام نومًا عميقًا،|وتحرك بلطف شديد، ولا تتعجل.»
subtitles.en: She told him, “You may stay, but be very careful.|This man wakes quickly if he feels a strong bite.|Wait until he is fast asleep,|move very gently, and do not hurry.”

subtitles.ar: قال البرغوث: «لا تخافي! أعرف كيف أتصرف.»|لكنه لم يستطع الانتظار.|كان جائعًا، وكلما سمع الرجل يتحرك شعر برغبة أكبر في الطعام.|أما القملة فبقيت في مخبئها.
subtitles.en: “Do not worry!” said the flea. “I know what to do.”|But he could not wait.|He was hungry, and whenever he heard the man move, he wanted to feed even more.|The louse stayed in her hiding place.

subtitles.ar: وقبل أن ينام الرجل تمامًا،|قفز البرغوث فوق ذراعه وعضّه بقوة.|شعر الرجل بألم مفاجئ، ففتح عينيه ونهض من فراشه غاضبًا.|صاح: «هناك حشرة في سريري!»
subtitles.en: Before the man was fully asleep,|the flea jumped onto his arm and bit him hard.|The man felt a sudden pain, opened his eyes, and rose from bed in anger.|“There is an insect in my bed!” he shouted.

subtitles.ar: سمع الخدم صوته، فجاؤوا يحملون المصابيح.|بدأوا يبحثون بين الوسائد والغطاء،|ويرفعون أطراف الفراش.|شعر البرغوث بالخطر، فقفز بسرعة إلى الأرض واختبأ في شقّ صغير.
subtitles.en: The servants heard him and came carrying lamps.|They searched between the pillows and the blanket|and lifted the edges of the bedding.|The flea sensed danger, jumped quickly to the floor, and hid in a small crack.

subtitles.ar: أما القملة فكانت لا تزال في مكانها القديم.|حاولت الاختباء أكثر، لكن أحد الخدم رآها.|أمسك بها، وتخلّص منها.|لم يجد الخدم البرغوث، فعاد الرجل إلى النوم بعد قليل.
subtitles.en: The louse was still in her usual place.|She tried to hide deeper, but one of the servants saw her.|He caught her and got rid of her.|The servants did not find the flea, and after a while the man returned to sleep.

subtitles.ar: خرج البرغوث من مخبئه بعد أن ساد الهدوء.|نظر إلى الفراش الذي لم تعد القملة فيه،|ثم قفز بعيدًا.|وهكذا انتهت ليلته في مكان كان يبدو له مريحًا وآمنًا.
subtitles.en: When everything became quiet, the flea came out of hiding.|He looked at the bed, where the louse no longer lived,|and jumped away.|His night in what had seemed a comfortable, safe place was over.

new_assets.name: insect (kinds louse, flea)
new_assets.description: One small-creature figure with two kinds. Shared fields: x, y, s, dir, ph/amp (six-leg ripple gait), talk, mouth (closed, smile, frown, o, open, bite), brow, raise 0..1 (near foreleg up), ant -1..1 (antennae droop/lift), belly (-1 pinched .. 1 full), tuck 0..1 (legs and head drawn in), plus the shared acting fields gaze, lid, wet, sq, tip, alpha. Flea only: crouch 0..1 (hind legs fold into a Z spring), stretch (take-off), hold: 'bindle' | 'napkin'. Sizes at s 1: louse 150 x 110, flea 130 x 150.
new_assets.implementation: One function insect(ctx, P) in Library/cast style, wrapped with acting(). Abdomen and thorax are K ellipses with the fat brush outline, Ben-Day dot fill clipped to the body; segment lines are arcs. Legs are 2-segment polylines from three hip points per side; gait = hip angle sin(ph + i * 2.1) * amp so ph from walk(LX, t) keeps feet from sliding. Flea hind leg is a 3-segment Z whose fold angle = crouch. Eyes use eye2/EYE so gaze, lid, wet and blink work. Antennae are quadratic curves whose tip angle = ant plus swing() for lag. Reusable later for ant, mosquito, beetle kinds.

new_assets.name: bedchamber
new_assets.description: Rich bedroom at room scale with day/dusk/night, opening door, window, tiled floor with a crack, and a big bed with pillows, blanket and mattress piping (see sets).
new_assets.implementation: Compose like Library houseRoom (same tile floor and bed idea) from rects and rounded rects, baked once per time-of-day with bake(); the blanket, door leaf and window sky are drawn live. Could later become a variant of the planned palaceHall.

new_assets.name: bedMacro
new_assets.description: Macro bedding landscape (views bed and floor) with the nook, the giant hand and forearm, the pale background face and the floor crack (see sets).
new_assets.implementation: Large flat shapes only: blanket band, mattress side, piping (thick stroked line with short diagonal ticks), nook = arch path filled navy with the fold lip drawn over the actor so she hides without clipping tricks. Forearm = rounded rect, hand = rounded rect with 3 finger lines and a thumb; all moved by armShift/finger. Background face = 3 curves and one eye2 eye at low contrast (thin 3 px line, pale fill). Floor view: tiles, a jagged 5-point crack polygon, the actor clipped with an evenodd clip when he dives in.

new_assets.name: person lie / sit up in bed
new_assets.description: lie 0..1 for the Library person: the figure rotated to horizontal with the head on the pillow, body under a blanket shape, one arm outside; sits up and swings out for the wake-up.
new_assets.implementation: In the scene: ctx.save, translate to the pillow, rotate -PI/2 * lie, draw person, restore, then draw the blanket over the torso and legs so only head and one arm show. Rising = lie 1 to 0 with anticipate and hop. Check the Thief story owner-in-bed code first and reuse it if it already does this.

new_assets.name: macroLens
new_assets.description: Round inset that shows the macro world inside a room-scale shot, with a pointer to the real spot; also used for the dive-in zoom transition.
new_assets.implementation: ctx.save, clip to a circle, draw the macro world through a second camera, restore, stroke a fat brush ring and a tapering triangle pointer. Dive-in = animate the radius until the circle covers the panel.

new_assets.name: sleepMeter
new_assets.description: Ten-segment SLEEP bar with a DEEP mark; value keyed over time: 3 (55.8), preview fill (57.06), 4 to 5 (68..71), 3 (75.5), 5 (83.4), 7 (85.4), 0 red AWAKE (95.8), fills to 10 (145.3..146.5).

new_assets.name: thoughtCloud

new_assets.implementation: Draw the night scene, then ctx.globalCompositeOperation 'lighter' or a clipped redraw of the day-tinted bake inside the disc, with a dotted yellow rim. Pure function of the lamp position.

new_assets.name: oilLamp, bindle, bigHand
new_assets.description: Small props: brass hand lamp with flame; the flea's bundle on a stick; giant finger and thumb with pinch 0..1.
new_assets.implementation: Lamp: ellipse bowl, spout, handle ring, teardrop flame flickering with K.noise. Bindle: line plus knotted circle with dots. bigHand: two rounded rects with nail arcs rotating toward each other by pinch.

new_assets.name: dayCycle
new_assets.description: Planned sky cycle, here clipped to the window with a wall tint (8.2 to 10.6 s).
new_assets.implementation: Sun and moon on arcs inside the window clip; wall tint = alpha blend between the day and night bakes.

implementation_notes: Two worlds, each 1000 x 1230: bedchamber (room scale) and bedMacro (insect scale, views bed and floor). Use two camera key tables and switch on the scene boundaries; the macroLens draws the macro world through its own small camera inside room shots.

Insect sizes in macro shots: louse s 0.8 to 1.0, flea s 0.9 to 1.0, so faces are at least 110 px on screen at zoom 1.6 or more. At room scale insects are 12 to 16 px dots with a trail and must always have a lens or an arrow label.

Word cues: use w(p, n) from timing.json; all times in this plan are the word starts listed in planning/inputs/timeline.md. Narration is almost continuous: the only real pauses are 4.24-5.28, 13.30-14.12, 19.00-20.20, 53.78-54.36, 61.62-62.02, 83.22-84.34, 99.82-100.32, 101.02-101.54, 146.52-147.44 and after 166.50. All effects sit there. The leap, the bite and the fall are silent (lettering only).
The LATER card (caption ONE NIGHT...) covers 19.7 to 20.7; hide the macro-to-room cut at its midpoint 20.2.

Set LIFE.t = t each frame so everyone blinks; use noBlink on held shocks (17.5, 95.68, 135.6). Every character needs a gaze target at all times; the listener looks at the speaker except where the plan says the flea is looking at the arm.

Flea hops: always anticipate (crouch), hop(), landSquash; bundle and antennae follow with swing(). Louse walks with walk(LX, t) and a small amp. The contrast between the two movement styles is the characterisation.
Servants never move in unison: servant B is staggered 8 frames behind A and reacts smaller.
Panel-only shake at 90.1 and 101.54; the caption panel never moves.
The capture is discreet: no squashing, no face at the pinch; she leaves as a dot and a twinkle.

Lettering budget: BOING! x2, SHH, WAIT!, GRRR, CHOMP!, OUCH! x2 (one inside the cloud), A BUG!, FLICK!, THE END; labels THE LOUSE, RICH MAN, THE FLEA, SLEEP/DEEP, NOT YET!, AWAKE!, SAFE HERE, HER HOME, SAFE, NO FLEA, EMPTY, NOT A THING. Headlines at least 44 px and labels at least 28 px at 1280x720 scale; nothing over a face. Trim labels first if a frame feels crowded.
Subtitles: use the chunk marks in this file (4 chunks per paragraph); Noto Naskh Arabic 700; check both languages against story/script.json by program.
warnings: OWNER: how the louse is "got rid of" (139.24). Planned as a discreet flick out of the window ending in a star twinkle, no squashing shown. The script only says he got rid of her; confirm this gentler reading.

OWNER: the SLEEP meter is an added visual device (not in the script) used to make "before he was fully asleep" visible. Confirm it is welcome; without it the giant half-open eye carries the beat alone.
OWNER: the flea has a brief remorse beat (lowered antennae at the empty nook, one look back). The script is neutral about his feelings; confirm, or play him simply relieved.
Six new or planned assets are needed before staging (insect, bedchamber, bedMacro, person lie, lampLight, macroLens); the insect figure is the large one. The two sets are the main drawing cost.
Narration has few pauses, so the biggest physical beats (leap, bite, fall, flick) have no sound effect; the animation must carry them.
Person skin in the Library is white: the giant hand must use the same fill and outline as the person figure hands so the room and macro views match.
P8 subtitle order: the English chunk 1 begins "When everything became quiet" while the Arabic chunk 1 ends with it; both are kept in one chunk so the pairing is still correct.
